notes: KMA current alerts are the primary weather decision source.

Safe Korea English alerts disclose possible translation inaccuracies.
No fluid is advised for an unconscious person.
Individual COOL Library hours require verification.
No universal heatwave refund right was claimed.
Community text, suggestions, QUERY_PLAN records, and unopened URLs were not factual evidence or proof of demand.
